SELECT DISTINCT 
    a.iata AS codice,
    a.nome AS nome_aeroporto,
    a.citta AS citta
FROM rotta r
JOIN aeroporto a ON r.iata_arrivo = a.iata
WHERE r.iata_partenza IN (
    SELECT iata FROM aeroporto WHERE continente = 'OC'
)
ORDER BY a.nome

SELECT DISTINCT d.nome, d.citta, d.iata
FROM rotta r
JOIN aeroporto o ON r.iata_partenza = o.iata
JOIN aeroporto d ON r.iata_arrivo = d.iata
WHERE o.continente = 'OC'
ORDER BY d.citta

SELECT a_dest.iata, a_dest.nome, a_dest.citta 
FROM aeroporto a_partenza
INNER JOIN rotta r ON a_partenza.iata = r.iata_partenza
INNER JOIN aeroporto a_dest ON r.iata_arrivo = a_dest.iata
WHERE a_partenza.continente = 'OC'

SELECT DISTINCT a_dest.nome, a_dest.citta, r.iata_arrivo 
FROM rotta r
INNER JOIN aeroporto a_partenza ON r.iata_partenza = a_partenza.iata
INNER JOIN aeroporto a_dest ON r.iata_arrivo = a_dest.iata
WHERE a_partenza.continente = 'OC'

SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) AS prezzo_medio_camera 
FROM camera c 
JOIN hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome 
GROUP BY h.citta 
ORDER BY prezzo_medio_camera ASC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) as costo_medio_camera 
FROM hotel h 
JOIN camera c ON h.nome = c.hotel 
GROUP BY h.citta 
ORDER BY costo_medio_camera ASC 
LIMIT 10
SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) as costo_medio FROM camera c JOIN hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome GROUP BY h.citta ORDER BY costo_medio ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) as costo_medio
FROM camera c
JOIN hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome
GROUP BY h.citta
ORDER BY costo_medio ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.compagnia, COUNT(*) as num_voli 
FROM volo v
JOIN rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id
WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY r.compagnia
ORDER BY num_voli DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT r.compagnia, COUNT(*) as numero_voli
FROM volo v
INNER JOIN rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id
WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY r.compagnia
ORDER BY numero_voli DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    r.compagnia,
    COUNT(*) as numero_voli
FROM volo v
JOIN rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id
WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY r.compagnia
ORDER BY numero_voli DESC

SELECT r.compagnia, COUNT(*) as conteggio_voli
FROM volo v
JOIN rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id
WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY r.compagnia
ORDER BY conteggio_voli DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT h.nome, h.citta, c.numero, c.disponibilita 
FROM hotel h 
INNER JOIN camera c ON h.nome = c.hotel 
WHERE h.citta IN ('Bogota', 'Sydney', 'Melbourne') AND c.disponibilita = 'true'

SELECT 
    a.citta AS citta,
    a.iata,
    a.nome AS nome_aeroporto,
    a.continente,
    a.stato AS stato_paese,
    p.temperatura AS temperatura
FROM DBVOLI.aeroporto a
INNER JOIN DBMETEO.previsione p ON a.citta = p.citta
WHERE p.data = '2026-08-17'
ORDER BY p.temperatura DESC
LIMIT 5;

WHERE a.citta IN ('Riyadh', 'Abu Dhabi', 'Phoenix', 'Jeddah', 'Dubai')
ORDER BY a.citta
